distribution.summary: 福建；贵州；云南；台湾；香港
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Guizhou, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports the first Taiwan record, based on 34 specimens from Nantou, Hui Son collected during 2004–2007. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) adds Fujian, with locality evidence from Longyan City, and also records Guizhou, Yunnan and Taiwan.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous but provides no enumerated host taxon in the curated field. Smith et al. (2022) reports Liquidambar formosana, which is promoted as the current confirmed host.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus alpha (Beeson, 1929).

taxonomic_history.name: Microperus alpha
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Microperus alpha (Beeson, 1929), VSN_3664. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes transfer from Coptodryas to Microperus by Saha & Maiti (1996); this transfer history is retained as nomenclatural provenance.
